{"text":"Within stone walls, in a hidden corner,
where silence reigns, and time feels slower.
Don’t look above, nor behind a door,
a secret awaits, but the path is more."}

{"text":"Look below, where the carpet lies,
lift it gently, with curious eyes.
It’s not a trap, but a passage concealed,
where darkness opens, and secrets are revealed."}

{"text":"A secret corner, beneath the cloth,
a click whispers, the path is soft.
Lift the carpet, the way you’ll see,
a hidden world, waiting to set you free."}
